Name: Raphtalia NPC AI dialogue (inworld)
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]
This mod adds AI generated dialogue to Raphtalia.
You can either use this mod together with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16816]Talk to Inworld's AI Villagers[/url]﻿ mod, or as standalone.
If you use it as a standalone ONLY Raphtalia will respond to your questions. If you want all other NPCs to respond as well, you have to download the mod above.

Raphtalia has knowledge about both The Rising of the Shield Hero and Stardew Valley.
You can ask her about for example locations of things like the saloon or blacksmith and she also knows about the villagers and where they live.

Let me know if there is any other knowledge you think she should have.

Just press T and use the chat to talk to her!
﻿
[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿.
2. Download and install my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10801]Raphtalia Mod[/url]﻿
3. Download and unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

This should work in multiplayer, but only the person asking questions will see the responses.[/center]
